lines.t: Then I was quiet yet heavy with knowing Bread in your hands, a mercy unfolding
You spoke of a body soon broken in love
A covenant written from heaven above
The cup you lifted, a promise of grace
Red as the mercy poured out in our place
You called us to remember, not just with words
But hearts awaken to all we have heard
In the stillness we see, what it cost to set us free
We remember you, in the breaking of the bread
In the pouring of the wine
Every word you said
We remember you
Lifted high upon that tree
Your body giving
Your blood for me
Betrayed in the garden, alone in the night
Carrying sorrow, yet walking in light
No one could bear what you carried for all
Still you surrender, still answer the call
Pierced for our healing, crushed for our sin
Love poured out so we could begin again
Oh, greater kindness the world has known
You gave your life to reclaim your own
And the veil was torn in two
So we could come to you
We remember you
In the breaking of the bread
In the pouring of the wine
Every word you said
We remember you
You lifted high upon that tree Your body giving Your blood for me
Not forgotten, not in vain Every drop, every pain
Still it speaks, still it saves Calling hearts out of the grave
You are risen, You are King
Still we gather, still we sing
Till You come, we proclaim
Every power in Your name
We remember You
In the breaking of the bread
In the pouring of the wine
Every word You said
We remember You
You, Lamb of God, who set us free Forever worthy, eternally
Till you return, we will stand and proclaim Yahushua, the Messiah, forever the same
We remember you
We remember you.
